Aiming to be a "watch for professional pilots", the model that appeared in 1984 is Breitling's representative series "Chronomat". Based on the opinions of the Italian Air Force acrobatic team "Fillecce Tricolori", it was produced based on the voices of real professionals. Among them, this is the "Chronomat 44" that appeared in the 2009 model change. Equipped with Breitling's first completely in-house developed and manufactured movement "Caliber 01". In addition to the reliability of the chronograph function, it has excellent practicality such as a power reserve of 70 hours and a date function that can be adjusted at any time. There are some small scratches, but it is in a beautiful state. We are doing overhaul and exterior finishing. *Accessories may have scratches, stains, or deterioration.
